purpose: Teach: 伐採/急性/海峡/激怒/不条理/醸造/戦艦/着工

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、森林伐採に頼らない素材を開発しろ
lines.en: Develop materials that don't rely on logging.
lines.style: Clipped, declarative authority. Tight breath before the opening noun. No wasted air. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の急性疾患予防プログラムを導入します
lines.en: Understood. We'll implement an acute illness prevention program for our staff.
lines.style: Measured affirmation with slight hesitation before the plan. Present the initiative as already thought-through but open to adjustment. Respectful deference in the pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 海峡を越えた取引も検討しろ
lines.en: Look into cross-strait transactions as well.
lines.style: Same crisp authority as the first line. 'As well' carries the weight—this is additional, not secondary. Brief and expectant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の激怒には誠実に対応いたします
lines.en: Understood. We'll respond to any concerns from our valued clients with complete sincerity.
lines.style: Formal assurance with careful precision. Slight emphasis on 「sincerity」—showing he understands the stakes. Steady, not rushed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の不条理を打開する新製品を目指せ
lines.en: Aim for new products that break through the industry's accepted limitations.
lines.style: Steady directional force. 'Break through' lands with intention. The opening is measured; the verb carries the vision. Slight rise at the period.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日本酒醸造との提携を検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're currently exploring a partnership with sake breweries.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact update delivered with quiet confidence. Emphasize the present work already underway. Tone says 'we're on top of this' without overstatement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、ロゴに戦艦のシルエットは使うな
lines.en: Don't use a battleship silhouette in our company logo.
lines.style: Direct prohibition delivered flatly, almost as a personal correction. Slight disdain for the choice itself. Final authority. No debate invited.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗の着工式を準備しております
lines.en: Understood. We're preparing for the groundbreaking ceremony at the new location.
lines.style: Final affirmation with controlled closure. Slightly warmer than previous updates—acknowledge the milestone. Even pace, clean finish.
